en.config.compressMaxTokens.hint: Maximum generated tokens per compression request; blank uses the model default.
en.config.compressModel.hint: Set with the compression provider; blank uses session routing.
en.config.compressProvider.hint: Set with the compression model; blank uses session routing.
en.config.compressReasoningEffort.hint: Reasoning effort for compression; blank uses the model default.
en.config.compressSkipReasoning.hint: Exclude historical reasoning from compression references.
en.config.debug.hint: Log processing steps; the default follows NODE_ENV.
en.config.description: Configure context compaction and original-text recall.
en.config.invalidInteger: Enter an integer; leave blank to use the default.
en.config.modelDir.hint: Directory containing the local semantic-enhancement embedding model.
en.config.observeThresholdTokens.hint: Uncompressed context in real main-model tokens that triggers observation.
en.config.omEnabled.hint: Enable observation and reflection of summaries. Turning it off also stops progress reminders.
en.config.progressReminderEnabled.hint: Inject a progress reminder asking the model to keep writing notes. Requires automatic compaction.
en.config.progressReminderIdleEnabled.hint: Resend the reminder when the model only calls tools without notes; off resends only when it is missing.
en.config.progressReminderIdleSteps.hint: Resend once this many finished steps have passed without notes; at least 1.
en.config.progressReminderIdleToolCalls.hin: Resend only when tool calls without notes exceed this value; at least 0.
en.config.rateLimitWaitMs.hint: Cooldown after a 429 response; zero skips the wait.
en.config.recompressConcurrency.hint: Maximum concurrent model-switch recompressions, at least one; extra runs wait in a queue.
en.config.reflectThresholdTokens.hint: History blocks total in real main-model tokens that archives older blocks in the background.
en.config.saveFailed: Save failed. Your changes are retained; check the values or retry.
en.config.semanticRecallEnabled.hint: Recall search matches by meaning; when off it matches strings.
en.config.tailMessageCount.hint: Full messages retained after observation is triggered.
en.config.unavailable: This plugin is unavailable and cannot be configured.
en.config.versionConflict: Configuration changed elsewhere. Reload before saving again.
en.eval.noEffort: This model has no reasoning effort levels
en.eval.pickModel: Pick a model on the left first
en.recompress.done: Recompression finished; the session record is in the log
en.recompress.effort.title: Reasoning effort
en.recompress.started: Compression started; it will be added to “Subagents” when done
